headline: Cabinet reshuffle: 4 new ministers and 2 state ministers take oath
summary: The Cabinet Division has distributed portfolios among the newly sworn-in ministers, including new appointments for LGRD, Information, and Civil Aviation.
details: The Cabinet Division published a gazette on Friday distributing portfolios among four ministers and two state ministers after they took oath at Bangabhaban.
caption:
Four new ministers and two state ministers have joined the cabinet in a reshuffle.

The Cabinet Division published a gazette on Friday distributing portfolios among four ministers and two state ministers after they took oath at Bangabhaban.

#Bangladesh #CabinetReshuffle #Politics #Bangabhaban #Government

Source: Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV

headline_marked: Nepal's President [[congratulates Mirza Fakhrul]] as Bangladesh's 23rd President
headline: Nepal's President congratulates Mirza Fakhrul as Bangladesh's 23rd President
summary: President Ram Chandra Paudel expressed his commitment to strengthening the long-standing friendly relations and deep bonds between the people of Nepal and Bangladesh.
details: Nepal's President Ram Chandra Paudel has congratulated Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir on becoming the 23rd President of Bangladesh.
In a message sent via the Nepal Embassy in Dhaka, President Paudel wished the new Bangladeshi president success in his new role.
The Nepalese leader emphasized his commitment to further strengthening the long-standing friendly relations between the two nations.
He also expressed a desire to see the deep existing bonds between the people of Nepal and Bangladesh become even more robust.
President Paudel expressed hope that the close and cordial relationship between the two neighboring countries will continue to evolve and flourish in the coming days.
caption:
Nepal's President sends a message of success and friendship to Bangladesh's new President Mirza Fakhrul.

Nepal's President Ram Chandra Paudel has congratulated Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir on becoming the 23rd President of Bangladesh.

In a message sent via the Nepal Embassy in Dhaka, President Paudel wished the new Bangladeshi president success in his new role.

The Nepalese leader emphasized his commitment to further strengthening the long-standing friendly relations between the two nations.

He also expressed a desire to see the deep existing bonds between the people of Nepal and Bangladesh become even more robust.

President Paudel expressed hope that the close and cordial relationship between the two neighboring countries will continue to evolve and flourish in the coming days.

#Bangladesh #Nepal #Diplomacy #MirzaFakhrul #InternationalRelations

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Jamuna TV
